assertion_results.text: Recommends NOT using a real SMTP server for the primary unit tests
assertion_results.evidence: "I generally would not start with a real SMTP server" and "Unit test: don't send email at all"

assertion_results.text: Asserts on what was sent (recipient/content/calls) via a mock or spy
assertion_results.evidence: "Mock the mail sender and verify your signup flow triggers the right call"; examples include "Correct recipient is passed" and "Correct template/data is passed"

assertion_results.text: Suggests isolating side effect from logic so the core decision can be tested purely
assertion_results.evidence: "The key thing I test separately is 'did we decide to send the email?' and 'can the email system deliver it?' Mixing those into one test makes failures much harder to diagnose."
